fato_historico: 2008: Mumbai attacks, a series of coordinated terrorist attacks took place in Mumbai killing 166 citizens by 10 terrorists of Lashkar-e-Taiba, a Pakistan based extremist Islamist terrorist organisation.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle awakening of your adventurous spirit. Even when the world feels heavy with shadows of past collective trials, you are encouraged to hold space for compassion. Perhaps today is a good time to shine your internal beacon, spreading warmth to those around you and finding strength in unity and quiet, mindful reflection.
frase_do_dia: Let your kindness be the lantern that guides others through the darkest of nights.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual insight and the bridge between two worlds.
conselho: Practice small acts of kindness to nurture your soul and uplift the community.
